transcript: I started the investigation similarly to how I start all my, um, investigations as I, I have a, uh, what's called a primary briefing, where all of my assisting, uh, detectives and, uh, criminalistics detectives, the scientific portion of the investigation, as well as, um, members of the command staff once everyone's present and all the representatives there are from OMI, the district attorney's office.
